description: all locations are stored in a graph structure, each have an unique description. both the graph and the descriptions are stored in this file.

edge_1.description: A broad urban road lined with apartment blocks, bus stops, and rows of street trees, connecting the dormitory area to the university campus within a short commute.

edge_2.description: A convenient town route passing cafés, stationery shops, and residential intersections, linking the university's main gate with the nearby supermarket.

edge_3.description: A practical daily path through the modern town center, allowing students and residents to walk or cycle quickly between the dormitory and the supermarket.

edge_4.description: Libra's private apartment door opens directly onto the sidewalk of Willow Lane, giving the home an immediate, physical exit into the neighborhood street network.

edge_5.description: Yunru's separate apartment has its own private entrance opening directly onto Willow Lane, next door to but independent from Libra's entrance.

edge_6.description: A short internal footpath links Libra's street-facing micro-apartment to the dormitory complex courtyard and shared service area without passing through Yunru's home.

edge_7.description: A separate short footpath links Yunru's street-facing micro-apartment to the dormitory complex courtyard and shared service area.

edge_8.description: A short, well-lit sidewalk route along Willow Lane leads to a neighborhood convenience store selling snacks, drinks, toiletries, and basic groceries.

edge_9.description: A sheltered bus stop sits a brief walk east along Willow Lane, connecting the residential block with the university and town center.

edge_10.description: A calm pedestrian route lined with trees and low-rise shops reaches a small neighborhood park with benches and a walking loop.

edge_11.description: A direct neighborhood route runs from Willow Lane through two residential intersections to the supermarket, suitable for walking, cycling, or a short bus ride.

edge_12.description: A regular urban bus corridor connects the Willow Lane stop to the university's main gate.

edge_13.description: A level sidewalk route connects the convenience store to a small neighborhood clinic and pharmacy.

edge_14.description: The dormitory complex's front pedestrian gate opens onto Willow Lane, integrating the residential block with the surrounding street network.

dormitory.description: A modern student dormitory complex in the middle of a well-developed town, with mid-rise residential buildings, shared laundry rooms, secure entry gates, vending machines, a small courtyard, and two street-facing independent micro-apartments used by Libra and Yunru. The apartments are separate homes with their own doors and are not internally connected.

university.description: A comprehensive urban university campus with teaching buildings, libraries, sports grounds, landscaped walkways, and a busy main gate opening directly onto the surrounding town's commercial streets.

supermarket.description: A bright medium-sized supermarket serving the neighborhood, featuring fresh produce, daily necessities, ready-to-eat meals, self-checkout counters, and a small underground parking area for local residents.

libra_apartment.description: Libra's private compact one-room apartment on the street-facing side of the dormitory block. It contains one main living room, a real exterior window, a bed, a compact kitchen corner with cabinets and a small refrigerator, and a private front door that opens directly onto Willow Lane. Chocolate is stored in the kitchen cabinet as normal household food. The apartment is fully separate from Yunru's home.

yunru_apartment.description: Yunru's private compact one-room apartment immediately next door to Libra's, with its own exterior window, bed, compact kitchen corner, storage, and a separate front door opening directly onto Willow Lane. The two apartments are neighboring units only; there is no shared interior passage or default access between them.

willow_lane.description: A short residential street running along the front of the dormitory block, with sidewalks, streetlights, bicycle parking, a few small storefronts, and direct entrances to Libra's and Yunru's apartments. It connects the homes to the wider neighborhood road network.

convenience_store.description: A small neighborhood convenience store within a few minutes' walk of the apartments, selling snacks, chocolate, drinks, simple meals, household supplies, and other daily necessities.

bus_stop.description: A sheltered neighborhood bus stop with route information, seating, and regular service toward the university, supermarket, and town center.

neighborhood_park.description: A small public park with shade trees, benches, a short walking loop, open grass, and a quiet seating area used by nearby residents.

neighborhood_clinic.description: A small neighborhood clinic with a general consultation room, basic first-aid services, and an attached pharmacy for routine health needs.
